description.value: The Office Pub & Grill is a neighbourhood pub and full-service restaurant in the Valleyview area of Kamloops, serving all-day breakfast alongside classic pub fare like wings, poutine, and burgers. The space features two separate dining rooms accommodating up to 30 people and a patio, making it a viable stop for cycling groups. Customer reviews highlight generous portions and attentive service, including at least one reviewer who specifically noted stopping in after a long drive.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and provides the primary evidence. The contact page and gallery page confirm the address as 2020B Falcon Rd., phone as (250) 374-7044, and email as officepubngrill@gmail.com. The menu page explicitly mentions 'vegan options' as a menu category, confirming vegetarian/vegan availability. No bike-specific infrastructure (racks, storage, visibility) is mentioned anywhere on the website, and no washroom, water refill, takeout, or Wi-Fi references appear in the fetched content. OSM coordinates place the business in North Shore, but the website address and url_discovery_notes both point to Falcon Road south — a coordinate discrepancy worth flagging.
concerns: OSM coordinates (lat 50.6794653, lon -120.2717367) appear to place the business in the North Shore area, but the website address and url_discovery_notes both indicate the actual location is 2020B Falcon Rd., Kamloops — likely in Valleyview/South Kamloops. OSM node should be re-mapped.

URL discovery confidence was flagged as 'uncertain / medium' — the website URL was discovered rather than sourced directly from OSM tags, though website content clearly matches the business name and Kamloops location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate full-service pub with road-tripper reviews and vegan menu options, but no bike-specific amenities are confirmed (rack, water refill, washrooms not explicitly mentioned), and the OSM coordinates appear to be misplaced (North Shore vs. Falcon Road south). Coordinate discrepancy should be resolved and at least one WWC required criterion confirmed before including.
